scope: Observed dynamic response, not a new formal certificate or physical quality PASS.

finiteWall.scope: Previously captured 27 fixed floor points; one bounce, eight rays, no feedback/environment/emission/filter. Color changes at32; only directional source turns off at64. Current and history are separate actual shader textures.
finiteWall.oldColorMetric: Least-squares old/new normalized RGB basis fraction; fit residual separately reported. A chroma-memory diagnostic, not an irradiance accuracy metric.

cameraTaa.scope: Existing fixed planar, moving-camera/real TAA test; source-qualified first exposure points, no RGB-based sample selection. This tests stale-history rejection, not general whole-scene spatial-filter trails.

v209.scope: 32 real HDR samples from a 720-render sequence. ROIs come only from source triangle intersections; sky and raster-boundary pixels are not receivers. Unknown D is counted separately, never black. No physical-reference RGB used in these temporal-change summaries.
